name: sessions-expiring-within
prompt: Ops needs to warn users before their session dies. Add func (s *Store) SessionsExpiringWithin(d time.Duration) []Session in session.go: it returns the LIVE sessions that will expire within d from now (remaining lifetime = ttl - (now - LastSeen) is strictly less than d and the session is still live). Results sort by remaining lifetime ascending (soonest expiry first), with ID ascending on ties. d <= 0 returns an empty slice. The store is not mutated.
